title: Quick-Fix Velvety Vietnamese Beef Fillet Bun
description: A resounding, velvety Vietnamese dish featuring beef fillet, mortar-pestle-pound, and gluten-free-friendly ingredients. Enjoy this easy-to-make meal in under 30 minutes!
instructions: Pound the beef fillet slices with a mortar and pestle to thin them out.
In a small bowl, whisk together the fish sauce, sugar, lime juice, and water to make the marinade.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic to the marinade and mix well.
Place the beef fillet slices in the marinade and let them sit for 5 minutes on each side.
In a separate pan, toast the peanuts or cashews over medium heat until fragrant.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan and toss them with the toasted peanuts or cashews.
Add the drained beef fillet slices to the pan and toss everything together.
Serve the beef and noodle mixture on a plate, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.
Serve with a side of peanut sauce, if desired.
Enjoy your delicious Quick-Fix Velvety Vietnamese Beef Fillet Bun!
